Set up. The brief job is saved to post in #strategic-random at 07:45 Chicago time each day, starting tomorrow (Oct 15). I replied to Ruth in the channel.

Two things to know:
- The Hermes gateway isn't running, so the job won't fire until it's started (`hermes gateway start`).
- The schedule is stored in UTC as 12:45 daily. That matches 07:45 Chicago until US daylight saving ends on Nov 1; after that it needs changing to 13:45 UTC.
